sources.title: JERA, Dell and RHAELM announce first AI infrastructure project at Chiba Thermal Power Station
sources.summary: MoU identifies Chiba Thermal Power Station as the first named site. Up to 400 MW AI infrastructure is planned for around 2028. Development is at announcement/business-feasibility stage; physical construction is not established.
sources.date_semantics: Article explicitly dated 2026/10/01 and says memorandum signed today. Status date is the announcement date, not a physical-work observation.
sources.capacity_scope_note: 40万kW is planned AI-data-center infrastructure capacity, not established live IT load. USD15bn includes land, power, construction and computing; no project finance close inferred.
